cod_assessment.drift_rationale: Panels substantially complete Jul 2026 with ~10-11 months to contractual In-Service (Oct 2026); site appears ahead of civil/racking schedule. Remaining risk: Lucero Station TIF construction by AEP (TSP), final electrical commissioning, grid synchronization. COD drift history: 5 changes over queue life (2025-07 → 2027-07), mostly front-loaded slippage. Most recent COD stable since Oct 2025. Financial security increased by $9.5M in Feb 2026 = continued commitment. Medium risk because TSP-side TIF completion is external to generator control.
